summary.zh: 更新体验优化：不再重复弹出更新提示，更新弹框排版更清爽，更新说明改用大白话。
summary.en: A cleaner update experience: no more duplicate update notices, a tidier update card, and plain-language release notes.

highlights.zh: 修复更新提示重复弹出的问题：打开更新弹框后，不再额外弹出一条重复的提示条。
highlights.en: Fixed duplicate update notices: opening the update card no longer triggers a second redundant tooltip.

highlights.zh: 更新弹框排版优化：移除标题旁的下载图标，「新增 / 改进 / 修复」分类改为醒目的小标题。
highlights.en: The update card gets a cleaner layout: the decorative download icon is gone and the New / Improved / Fixed labels are now proper section headings.

highlights.zh: 更新说明改用大白话：每条只说这一版做了什么，技术细节不再出现在更新内容里。
highlights.en: Release notes are rewritten in plain language: each item states what changed, without technical detail.
